study_strategy.warning: Do not count Liatris mucronata as a separate species; it is a synonym of accepted L. punctata var. mucronata.

quick_split: var. mucronata — often glossy/reddish-stemmed locally; smaller more spheroid corm
var. punctata — often grayer/more pubescent locally; larger corm and larger hairier achenes
comparison_lesson.caveat: North Hays stem-color/pubescence cues are useful locally but should not replace corm and fruit characters elsewhere.
